name: Llama-3.3-Nemotron-Super-49B-v1

lifecycle.note: Open weights still downloadable from NVIDIA's Hugging Face organisation. NVIDIA has marked only its hosted API endpoint on build.nvidia.com as deprecated (see notes); no deprecation of the model weights was found.

summary.text: Llama-3.3-Nemotron-Super-49B-v1 is an open-weights reasoning language model from NVIDIA, released at GTC 2025 as the Super size of the Llama Nemotron family and also offered as a hosted API. NVIDIA reduced Meta's Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct to 49B parameters with neural architecture search and distillation, targeting a single H100 GPU; reasoning is switched on or off in the system prompt.

features.note: Reasoning on or off is selected through the system prompt.

openWeights.note: Governed by the NVIDIA Open Model License; the Llama 3.3 Community License Agreement also applies (Built with Llama).

contextWindowTokens.note: The model overview also gives the context length as 128K tokens.

access.note: Hosted preview API and NIM microservice on build.nvidia.com at release; NVIDIA has since marked the hosted API deprecated (no longer supported after 08/25/2026).

notes: Released at GTC 2025 together with Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-8B-v1. On 2025-01-06 NVIDIA had announced Nano, Super and Ultra sizes of the Llama Nemotron family without naming models or describing reasoning; that tier announcement is not treated as the announced date of this model. NVIDIA describes the model as a derivative of Meta Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct built with neural architecture search and distillation (cross-organisation relation, not stored here). The Hugging Face repository id uses an underscore (Llama-3_3); https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Llama-3.3-Nemotron-Super-49B-v1 redirects to it. An FP8 checkpoint was added later in nvidia/Llama-3_3-Nemotron-Super-49B-v1-FP8 (repository created 2025-05-13 per Hugging Face metadata), kept as an alias. The developer blog also calls the model Llama 3.3 Nemotron 49B Instruct. Hosted API: the build.nvidia.com page marks the endpoint nvidia/llama-3.3-nemotron-super-49b-v1 deprecated on 08/25/2026 and the id is no longer in NVIDIA's public model list (integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/models) on 2026-10-02; this concerns the hosted endpoint only, so the lifecycle follows the open weights, which remain downloadable. Succeeded in the Super tier by Llama-3.3-Nemotron-Super-49B-v1.5 (relation stored on that record).
